d.e: Several months ago, users on 4chan and Reddit, the online message forums, started using the term NPC to refer to liberals. These people, they said, join the anti-Trump crowd not because they are led by independent thought or conscience to oppose President Trump’s policies, but…

d.t: To act as an NPC (“non-player character”) in a game.
d.e: All characters wish to submit to the game must be either netural or good even though the group will have to interact with evil beings as well. To preserve the group from being totally dark and paranoid, I will NPC the evil characters.

d.t: "nil per os" (nothing by mouth - nothing may be eaten or drunk).
